title: Attractive, large soap dispenser that dispenses too little soap for my tastes
text:
Attractive, large soap dispenser that dispenses too little soap for my tastes. I really like this dispenser except for the fact that it dispenses just too little soap even on the highest setting. I attached four pictures. The second photo shows the dispenser bottom removed with instruction booklets. The third shows the top battery compartment removed. The fourth shows how much the dispenser actually dispenses. From left to right is the largest to smallest amount released.

The bottom of this unit holds the soap and the top holds the batteries and controls how much soap will be dispensed. There is an on/off switch under the cap in case one wants to turn the unit off for moving. The instructions are written by someone who has English as a second language and it is not well written, yet they are still understandable.

In order to get the air out of the unit, I dispensed water. It does dispense water generously. However, due to the thickness of any soap, dispensing slows down. I do not want to water down my soap. I got this to release dish detergent and it comes out in a tiny dribble at the highest setting. I would have preferred twice the amount.

In summary, the unit is attractive and large and it does what it is supposed to do when dispensing nothing thicker than water. Nevertheless, when using soap, the dispensing action slows to a mere tiny trickle. Note that this will not dispense into clear glass. In other words, if I want soap to release into a glass container, it will not work. It actually has to see my hand or sponge to release. However, this is to be expected because glass acts like nothing to the sensor but I did not think of this because I often bring up the dish to the soap to dispense.

UPDATE December 6, 2018: I have been using this daily and noticed that it takes about three times to get soap to dispense if it has not been in use for about 30 minutes. This is very annoying. It is as if air gets in the line or the soap goes back down to the bottom of the straw and takes time to come to the top again.

UPDATE December 12, 2018: Although this is operating the same as I described in my update above, I am getting increasingly annoyed with this dispenser. As a result, I have lowered the ranking from 3 stars (a.k.a. 2.5 stars) to 2 stars. Every time that the dispenser has not been in continuous use, I have to try 3 or 4 times to get it to work before it starts dispensing again. At this point I am beyond annoyed.

UPDATE December 22, 2018: I tried so hard to use this soap dispenser and it just dispenses too little soap to be useful. I threw it in the garbage today.
